proposal_title: Deletion of GenerationJob.track_mode from Canonical Domain Schema
domain_specific_rationale: From a relational modeling and schema normalization perspective, track_mode represents worker dispatch/execution routing infrastructure rather than an intrinsic domain entity property of GenerationJob: 1) Decoupling Infrastructure from Core Schema: Purging track_mode from domain-entities.schema.json eliminates domain schema pollution and prevents schema migrations whenever worker execution modalities change or expand; 2) Alignment with Physical Table Schema: In DATA_MODEL.md, the operational channel is tracked via flow_track where appropriate, avoiding conflicting legacy track_mode fields in domain entities; 3) Formal Governance Ratification: Formally ratifies the removal that was identified during FA-003, ensuring 100% governance compliance.
capability_impact: Protects CAP-01 (Canonical Core State) and database schema cleanliness by enforcing clean separation of domain state and operational execution mechanisms.
residual_risk: None. Downstream worker routing adapters utilize provider request contracts and flow_track without relying on legacy track_mode.
